pr_title: ESQL: Properly handle multi-values in fold() and date math
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/100497

MV are treated as single values when the collection has actually only one value; when the collection has multiple values, the functions will return null.
pr_comments: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

### Problem Description

The following ESQL statement reports and unhandled error:

```

```

Returns the rror:
```
class_cast_exception - class java.util.ImmutableCollections$ListN cannot be cast to class java.lang.Number (java.util.ImmutableCollections$ListN and java.lang.Number are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')
```
